## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Release Checklist

- [ ] Version bump is documented in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] cargo fmt has been run and passes
- [ ] cargo test has been run for added or changed functionality and passes
- [ ] cargo clippy has been run and passes
- [ ] No errors remain for this release
- [ ] No personal or private data is introduced (tokens, passwords, usernames, API keys, credentials, private identifiers)
